title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. 8-K Filing — April 23, 2026
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026 disclosing the closing of $10 billion in registered debt offerings across four tranches of notes maturing between 2030 and 2037, including floating rate and fixed-to-floating rate structures.
key_points: Closed $500 million Floating Rate Notes due 2030
Closed $2.75 billion Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due 2030
Closed $3 billion Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due 2032
Closed $3.75 billion Fixed-to-Floating Rate Notes due 2037
Offerings registered under Securities Act of 1933 (File No. 333-285537)
Legal opinion provided by Simpson Thacher & Bartlett LLP
